name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
steps: Step onto the knee raise station and rest your forearms on the pads.
Press your back against the back pad and let your legs hang.
Breathe out and lift your knees toward your chest.
Curl your hips slightly at the top, then lower slowly.

common_mistakes.fix: Pause at the bottom before each rep

common_mistakes.mistake: Shoulders shrugging up to the ears
common_mistakes.fix: Press down into the forearm pads
